summary: line-through exfiltrates host and CI metadata to webhook.site on install
details: The package's package.json preinstall hook runs vishu.js, which at npm install time collects the installer's public IP (via api.ipify.org), OS hostname, and GitHub Actions / CI environment variables (CI, GITHUB_ACTIONS, GITHUB_WORKFLOW, GITHUB_RUN_ID, and related identifiers), then sends them as query parameters in an HTTPS GET to a hardcoded collector at https://webhook.site/66059630-2030-4b44-b2df-d37e02be0a7d. It also performs a DNS lookup encoding the hostname as a subdomain of an out-of-band collaborator domain (left as the placeholder your-collab-domain.oastify.com). Behavior fires automatically on npm install with no user interaction.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
